projects.name: Door & Scanning

documents.title: Door ops: resetting a scanner mid-event
documents.content:
Written after Homecoming, updated after Winter Formal. Print it and leave a copy on the check-in table. This is for whoever is running the door, not for engineering.

## Before doors open

- Every door phone signed in on the door account for **that** event, not last week's.
- Door code typed in on each phone. Host finds it under Event > Doors on the dashboard. Six characters, it changes per event.
- Brightness up, low power mode off. Low power mode is the single most common reason a camera preview is slow.
- One spare phone charged and signed in, sitting in the cash box.

## The camera preview is black

1. Lock the phone, unlock it, wait three seconds.
2. Still black: swipe up to force quit ExampleCo Scan, reopen, go back into the event.
3. Still black after that: take the spare phone out of the cash box and put the dead one on the charger. Do not stand there restarting it with forty people in line.

## The screen sits on Scanning...

1. Give it ten seconds. On bad venue wifi it can take that long.
2. Tapping Scan again does not make it go faster. Write down the time on the phone and move that guest to the other scanner.
3. If it happens twice in a row on the same phone, switch that phone to LTE (Settings > Wi-Fi > off) and carry on. Half the venues we work have wifi that is worse than nothing.

## It says Session expired

Settings > Door > Sign out, sign back in on the door account, re-enter the door code. Takes about forty seconds. If the code is not accepted, ask the host to read it off the dashboard again rather than typing what you think you remember.

## Falling back to the list

If both phones are down, the host can pull the attendee list on the dashboard (Event > Guests > Export). Check names off on paper, write the time next to each, and hand the sheet to the host at the end of the night. Tell them up front that the numbers on their scan screen will not include the paper ones.

## What to send support afterwards

We get "scanning was weird last night" a lot and we can do nothing with it. Send:

- Event name and which door you were on
- The time on the phone when it happened, not "around eleven"
- The guest's name, and a photo of the screen if you got one
- Whether the other door had already scanned that guest
- Phone model, iOS version, whether you were on wifi or LTE

support@ExampleCo.example, or reply on the Intercom thread if the host already opened one.
documents.creator: wes

documents.title: Release notes: host web + scanner app
documents.content:
Newest first. Host-visible changes only. Internal cleanups go in the PR description, not here.

## 2026-02-19 - scanner app 4.8.1

- Torch button works on the smaller iPhones again (IOS-1488).
- Guest search matches names with accents (IOS-1560).
- Bumped the minimum supported version to iOS 17.

## 2026-02-04 - host web

- Attendee list export as CSV, from Event > Guests (WEB-630).
- Payout rows show the date the transfer left, not the date it was queued (WEB-602).

## 2026-01-21 - host web

- Scan status page loads without the eight second stare on events over ~2k tickets (WEB-618).
- Revenue by ticket type renders for free events instead of showing an empty card (WEB-588).

## 2025-12-17 - scanner app 4.7.4

- Camera comes back after the phone is unlocked mid-event (IOS-1588).
- Door invite codes stop expiring the moment they are sent (IOS-1640).

## 2025-11-25 - host web

- Fixed the checkout typo two hundred and some hosts told us about (WEB-598).

## 2025-10-08 - create event

- Form v2 behind the flag for design partners. Ten schools on it as of this week.
- Map pin no longer crashes outside the US (IOS-1455).

## Known and open

- Door counts that do not agree with what the door team counted by hand. Tracked in Door & Scanning; do not promise hosts a date on calls yet.
documents.creator: marcus

issues.title: scanning inconsistent
issues.description:
From Wes and the door team at Fall Formal (Sat 11 Oct, three doors, ~900 sold).

Same QR, two scanners, two different answers. Front door said approved, side door said already scanned about a second later. It went the other way at least once too, side door approved somebody the front door had already let in.

Separately: the clicker count at the door and the number on the host's scan screen were 30+ apart by the end of the night. Host asked which one to believe and I didn't have an answer for her.

Gets worse when the line is long. At the quiet events nobody complains.
issues.creator: sam

comments.body: Third event this month with the same shape of complaint. Kappa Sig 27 Sep, Delta house 4 Oct, Fall Formal 11 Oct. All three-plus doors, all sold over 500. I have the Intercom threads if anyone wants them.

I was on the front door. From about 23:35 to midnight there were two of us scanning the same line because it got long, and that is the window all of it happened in.

One guest got in on the side door, then his friend scanned the same screenshot at the front and got in too. I only found out because the guest told me about it, laughing.

Have the server logs for that window. The two doors' requests for that guest are about 40ms apart and both come back success. Nothing errored, nothing timed out, in the log it reads like two ordinary scans. Digging.
Moving this up. Two hosts brought it up on renewal calls this week and one of them counted heads at the door themselves to prove it.

Still on it. Can get the same two answers on dev with two terminals firing at the same instant, so it is not the phones and it is not the venue wifi. The broken write seam is `admitSingleItem` and `admitMultipleItems` in `internal/v2/endpoints/events/host/scan.go`; the host pages also depend on the stubbed `gelscan` readers.

issues.title: ticket came back approved after it was already used
issues.description:
Copying the host's message across from Intercom:

> hey - we had someone get in on a ticket that had already been scanned. my bouncer scanned a girl at 10:52, then like 20 min later a different guy scanned the same ticket at the other door and it went green. we only caught it becuase she was standing right there talking to me

Winter Kickoff, Fri 7 Nov. Two doors. Host is Theta Chi, acct 88213.
issues.creator: kev

comments.body: Asked the host for the ticket id and which door was which. She is a student, so expect a couple of days.

Tried this on dev about twenty times with two phones and could not get it to happen once. Both doors were on the house wifi that night per the host. Marking done for now, if it comes back we will at least have a second data point.

Reopening. Same host, different event (their formal, 5 Dec). Two people through one ticket again. She sent the id this time: RI-88213-0442, scanned 21:58 and again 22:31, and she says the second one was at the door running off a phone hotspot.
This has been closed twice now on nobody being able to make it happen at a desk. Putting it in the door project instead of closing it a third time.
Same shape as WEB-615. Leaving both open until the door work lands, then we go back to the two hosts and ask them to watch for it.

issues.title: scanner said approved on a guest who was already inside
issues.description:
Bouncer at Sigma Nu (Sat 22 Nov) says the app approved a scan for someone who was already in the building. He scanned, it spun for a few seconds, he tapped scan again, and it went green. The guest list on the host's laptop showed that ticket as used from half an hour earlier.

iPhone 12, iOS 18.1, scanner app 4.7.2. Venue wifi was unusable so he was on LTE with about one bar.
issues.creator: wes

comments.body: Got the device log off his phone (attached). The first tap did leave the phone. There is a request at 22:41:03 that never got a response on the phone side, and the second tap at 22:41:19 came back success.
Spent an afternoon on this with the network link conditioner, dropping the response every time, and the app behaved. Closing as not reproducible, reopen with a second report.
Reopening, I watched it happen at Winter Formal. Scanner spun, bouncer tapped again, and a second person walked in on the same QR. Two different people, I was standing next to him.
Then this is the same thing WEB-615 and WEB-621 are about, from the phone's side. Moving it into the door project so it is not sitting on its own in the iOS backlog.

issues.title: video: scanner spins then approves twice
issues.description:
Host sent a video (attached). Sigma Chi Winter Formal, 6 Feb. You can see the screen sit on Scanning..., then two greens back to back on what she says was the same guest and his roommate.

No ticket id, no times beyond what is on the video, and she has since handed the account over to next year's social chair.
issues.creator: kev

comments.body: Video is 42 seconds, shot over the bouncer's shoulder in the dark. You cannot read the QR and you cannot read the guest's name on the confirmation.

Watched it four times at quarter speed. I genuinely cannot tell whether that is one ticket twice or two people with similar screenshots. There is no event id anywhere in the frame and the host account is closed, so I have nothing to match it against.
Nobody has managed to reproduce anything from this video. Canceling. If we get a report with an event and a time on it we can chase that one properly instead.

issues.title: revenue by ticket type is an empty card on free events
issues.description: Host with a free event opens analytics and the revenue by ticket type card renders with nothing in it, no axis, no empty state. Looks broken rather than zero.
issues.creator: marcus

comments.body: Copy for the empty state: "No revenue yet - this event is free." Design signed off in the thread.

issues.title: push not delivered when the app is backgrounded on 18.2
issues.description:
Reminders and "doors are open" pushes do not arrive if the app has been backgrounded for more than a few hours. Only on 18.2 as far as we can tell, 17.x is fine.

About 40 reports since the OS went out.
issues.creator: kev

comments.body: Our payload is over the size limit on the newer OS once we add the event image. Trimming it and testing on a device farm build.
Support macro updated to stop telling people to reinstall, that was doing nothing.

issues.title: payouts page says pending for events that already paid out
issues.description: Host sees Pending on the payouts page for an event whose money landed in their bank four days ago. Three tickets this week. The bank date is right in Stripe, we are showing the queued date and calling it the status.
issues.creator: sam

comments.body: Hosts read Pending as "we have not been paid" and then email us. Worth doing before the spring season.

issues.title: scan status page takes ~8s to load on big events
issues.description: Anything over roughly two thousand tickets and the scan status page is an eight second stare on a spinner. Hosts refresh it, which does not help.
issues.creator: delia

comments.body: Measured on the Homecoming event, 2,340 tickets: 7.8s median over ten loads, and the page is doing it again on every tab focus.

issues.title: camera stays black after unlocking the phone
issues.description: Bouncer locks the phone between guests, unlocks it, and the preview is black until the app is force quit. Reported at four events. Workaround is in the door ops note.
issues.creator: wes

comments.body: We were not restarting the capture session when the app came back to the foreground. Fixed in 4.7.4.

issues.title: date picker jumps to today when you edit a saved event
issues.description: Open an event that is already scheduled, change anything, and the date field resets to today. Two hosts have published events on the wrong day because of this.
issues.creator: sam

comments.body: One of the two was a paid event with 300 tickets already sold, so we also had to move everyone. Please can this go in the next cycle.
It is form v2 only, the old form is fine. Started when the field moved to the shared component.

issues.title: my event disappeared when i backgrounded the app
issues.description:
> i spent like an hour on the event, took a call, came back and everything was gone. had to start over and i gave up

Second one of these this month. Nothing is saved until publish.
issues.creator: kev

comments.body: Fifth or sixth time hosts have asked for drafts. Keeps getting rolled into the revamp and then falling out of it.

issues.creator: marcus

issues.title: scan tab and analytics tab give different numbers
issues.description:
Host screenshotted both tabs side by side about ten minutes apart at their formal. Scan tab said 412 scanned, analytics said 380 people through the door at the last bucket. She wanted to know which one to put in her report to the chapter.

Might be the bucket boundary, might not be.
issues.creator: kev

comments.body: Parking this next to WEB-615 rather than chasing it on its own, the same events keep turning up in both.

issues.title: export the attendee list as CSV
issues.description:
Hosts ask for this constantly. Right now support pulls it by hand, which is maybe six times a week in season and takes ten minutes each because we go through the admin panel.

Needs name, email, ticket type, whether they came through the door and when.
issues.creator: sam

comments.body: This is also what the door team falls back to when both phones are down, so please keep the scan time column in it.

issues.title: door invite code expires immediately
issues.description: Host adds a bouncer, bouncer taps the link that evening and gets "this invite has expired". Codes are supposed to last a week.
issues.creator: kev

comments.body: Expiry was being written in seconds and read in milliseconds. Classic.

issues.title: org invite email links to the wrong workspace
issues.description: New chapter officer accepts an invite and lands in the previous school's workspace. Happened twice during onboarding week.
issues.creator: marcus

comments.body: Both accounts cleaned up by hand. Nothing was visible to them that should not have been, checked the audit log.

issues.creator: sam

issues.title: event reminder went out at 4am local
issues.description: Reminder for a Saturday event fired at 04:12 on the Saturday for everyone in Mountain time. About 900 people got woken up. We scheduled in UTC and never converted.
issues.creator: marcus

comments.body: Twelve one-star reviews mentioning it. Support has a macro out apologising.

issues.title: payout screen shows $0 until you pull to refresh
issues.description: Open the payouts tab from the event, it is zero. Pull down, the real number appears. Hosts message us about it about once a week.
issues.creator: sam

issues.title: crash dropping a pin outside the US
issues.description: Create event, move the map to Montreal, drop a pin, app dies. Reproducible on every device we tried. Crashlytics has 340 sessions.
issues.creator: priya

comments.body: Postal code comes back empty and we force unwrap it. Two line fix, shipping with the form v2 build.

issues.title: support tool: refund a whole event in one go
issues.description:
When an event is cancelled we refund one ticket at a time through the admin panel. The last cancellation was 640 tickets and took two of us most of a day.

Does not need to be pretty. A list, a confirm, and something that tells us where it got to if it stops halfway.
issues.creator: sam

comments.body: Writing the runbook for it while noor builds the endpoint. I will own the tool once it is out.
Endpoint is on staging. Do not point it at prod yet.

issues.title: canned replies for door complaints
issues.description: Every scanning report currently gets a hand written reply and we are asking for different things each time. Want three saved replies: one asking for the event and the time, one for the phone details, one for when we cannot match a report to anything.
issues.creator: kev

comments.body: Lifting the questions straight off the door ops note so we ask for the same six things every time.
